PR06: subscribe the direct canvas surface to the presentation coordinator

The direct PlateLayoutContext.canvasSurface handle rendered the shared
canvas builder without listening to the presentation coordinator, so a
command- or config-driven multi-select change published presentation
state while the mounted PlateManagedEditor kept its previous interaction
mode until an unrelated rebuild. The surface now re-reads presentation-
driven shell state from the coordinator through a guarded listener
(deferring rebuilds during build/layout, matching the region canvas
panel), so the compatibility canvas, regions.canvas, and the canvas
surface all converge on the same live source. A widget test mounts the
surface directly and covers command- and config-driven transitions.
